user.title: Add an RV
user.description: Create an RV profile. Vehicle details are optional. Dimensions use meters or feet, and tank capacities use liters or US gallons according to the selected measurement system.

data_description.name: A unique name for this RV profile.
data_description.coach_year: The model year of the coach.
data_description.manufacturer: The chassis manufacturer, for example Prevost.
data_description.coach_builder: The company that built or converted the coach, for example Liberty.

data_description.overall_height: Meters for metric, or feet for US customary.

data_description.gray_water_tank_capacity: Liters for metric, or US gallons for US customary.

data_description.rear_axle_count: Count all rear axle assemblies, including the tag axle if present. One means a single main rear axle; two means one main axle and a tag axle; three means two main axles and a tag axle. The front axle is not included.
data_description.main_rear_wheel_configuration: Whether the main rear axle has single or dual wheels.
data_description.tag_axle_wheel_configuration: Choose the tag axle wheel layout when the rear axle assembly count is greater than one.
data_description.power_entities: Select existing sensors, controls, or climate entities for the RV power system.
data_description.water_entities: Select existing sensors, controls, or climate entities for the RV water system.
data_description.fresh_water_tank_level: Select the fresh-water tank level source: a sensor, number entity, or input number helper. Template sensors appear as sensors. Leave blank when no source is available.
data_description.gray_water_tank_level: Select the gray-water tank level source: a sensor, number entity, or input number helper. Template sensors appear as sensors. Leave blank when no source is available.
data_description.black_water_tank_level: Select the black-water tank level source: a sensor, number entity, or input number helper. Template sensors appear as sensors. Leave blank when no source is available.
data_description.fresh_water_tank_warning: Percent full that raises a warning when the tank is low. Set together with the problem level, or leave both blank.
data_description.fresh_water_tank_problem: Percent full that raises a problem when the tank is low. Must be below the warning level.
data_description.gray_water_tank_warning: Percent full that raises a warning when the tank is high. Set together with the problem level, or leave both blank.
data_description.gray_water_tank_problem: Percent full that raises a problem when the tank is high. Must be above the warning level.
data_description.black_water_tank_warning: Percent full that raises a warning when the tank is high. Set together with the problem level, or leave both blank.
data_description.black_water_tank_problem: Percent full that raises a problem when the tank is high. Must be above the warning level.
data_description.chassis_entities: Select existing sensors, controls, or climate entities for the RV chassis.
data_description.climate_entities: Select existing sensors, controls, or climate entities for RV climate systems.
data_description.location_entities: Select existing sensors, controls, or climate entities for RV location.
data_description.other_entities: Select other existing entities to include with this RV.
data_description.house_battery_bank_count: Defaults to one bank. Each bank is a complete independent unit. Use zero if absent.
data_description.chassis_battery_bank_count: Defaults to one bank. Each bank is a complete independent unit. Use zero if absent.
data_description.configure_power_sources: Configure each battery bank, inverter, generator and shore-power device on the following screens, or map them later in Options.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure RV profile
reconfigure.description: Update the saved vehicle details for this RV. The profile name and existing system/tire mappings are not changed.

power_source.title: Configure {source}
power_source.description: Map read-only readings for this independent source. Battery voltage/current describe the DC bank; inverter, generator and shore readings describe AC output/supply. Enabled is not proof of supplying power. Charging is a separate battery status, not inferred from current or another source. Leave unknown sources and capacity blank. Placement is optional; left/right are viewed facing forward.

data_description.voltage: Sensor, number or input number. Compatible units convert to V; unitless sources are interpreted as V.
data_description.current: Sensor, number or input number. Compatible units convert to A; unitless sources are interpreted as A. The source determines current sign.
data_description.enabled: Binary sensor, switch or input boolean with on/off states. Read-only; no actions are forwarded.
data_description.charging: An explicit binary sensor, switch or input boolean reporting whether this bank is charging. Independent of Enabled and of source availability.
data_description.nominal_voltage: 12, 24 or 48 V DC. Defaults to 24 V; confirm your actual bank specification.
data_description.nominal_capacity: Total capacity of this complete bank in ampere-hours. No assumed capacity or battery-series/parallel calculation.
data_description.location: Not shown by default. Shore power appears outside the RV on the selected side.

init.title: Map RV system entities
init.description: Choose existing entities for RV systems, optional water-tank levels, and each generated tire. Tank and tire readings accept sensors, number entities, input number helpers, and template sensors (which appear in Home Assistant as sensors). Readings and limits reload when you change these options.
